visual_goal: Show how the templates reference each other: the capability map and sourcing card decide what is built, decision records change owners, facts carry an envelope citing the license, and every answer sold cites fact versions, license and entitlement.
prompt: A left-to-right network illustration of nine document cards, each a small sheet with a folded corner. Top row, left to right: 'Capability map', 'Sourcing card', 'Decision record'. Middle row, left to right: 'Entity–owner table', 'Provenance envelope' shown as a green envelope, 'API contract', 'Journey SLO'. Bottom row: 'License card' directly below and between 'Provenance envelope' and 'API contract', and 'Entitlement matrix' directly below 'API contract' to its right. Arrows: from 'Capability map' to 'Sourcing card' labeled 'grades'; from 'Sourcing card' to 'Decision record'; from 'Decision record' down-left to 'Entity–owner table' labeled 'changes owner'; from 'Entity–owner table' to 'Provenance envelope'; from 'Provenance envelope' to 'API contract' labeled 'fact versions'; two unlabeled arrows from 'License card', one up-left to 'Provenance envelope' and one up-right to 'API contract'; one unlabeled arrow from 'Entitlement matrix' up to 'API contract'; from 'API contract' to 'Journey SLO'. Only three arrows carry labels: 'grades', 'changes owner', 'fact versions'. These labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Capability map leads to the sourcing card and decision record, which changes the entity–owner table; the owner table and license card feed the provenance envelope; envelope, license card and entitlement matrix feed the API contract, which feeds the journey SLO.
